ValidationRule.description: Validates that Start Date and Contract Term Months are entered when creating a Quote for non-Professional Services Opportunities.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), NOT(ISBLANK(OpportunityId)), Opportunity.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Opportunity", OR( ISBLANK(StartDate), ISBLANK(Contract_Term_Months__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Requires Start Date and Contract Term Months to be populated when creating a Quote from an Opportunity whose record type is not Professional Services.
